company.name: Alna Dietetique & Bio
company.distributes: Sugar-free chocolate, biscuits, healthy snacks, muesli and keto products from other brands (chocolate, biscuits, snacks)

company.sf_brands_carried: Belvas no added sugar chocolates and truffles; Chokay organic chocolate
what_they_do_well: Runs a central Geneva shop beside Cornavin plus a national online shop with free delivery from CHF 80.
company.fit_rationale: A Geneva health food shop with dedicated sugar-free chocolate, biscuits, snacks and keto sections, exactly the shelf Diablo's no added sugar range belongs on. It sells other brands such as Belvas and Chokay and ships across Switzerland from its online shop.

company.name: Bachli Bergsport

company.channels_supplied: 15 stores in Switzerland, the nearest to Geneva in Lausanne and Conthey, plus its online shop delivering nationwide
what_they_do_well: Runs 15 mountain sports stores across Switzerland, two of them in French-speaking Switzerland.
company.fit_rationale: A Swiss mountain sports chain with 15 stores that sells branded energy bars and snacks to outdoor shoppers. It has no Geneva store and reaches Geneva through its online shop and its Lausanne store, hence tier 3.

company.name: drogi.ch GmbH
company.distributes: Protein bars and protein snacks from other brands (More Protein, ESN) and glucose sweets (Livsane) in its sports nutrition range
company.channels_supplied: Its own online drugstore shipping across Switzerland by DPD, and a drugstore in Escholzmatt
company.sf_brands_carried: Protein bars and snacks from More Protein and ESN
what_they_do_well: Online drugstore with over 25 years in the drugstore trade.
company.fit_rationale: A Swiss online drugstore with a sports nutrition range that already sells bars and sweets from outside brands. Diablo's bars and sweets would sit with these health-conscious lines. Tier 3 because it is a smaller online shop.

company.name: HighPowered Fitness
company.distributes: Fitness supplements and equipment with protein and energy bars from Barebells and TREK (bars)
company.channels_supplied: Online shop shipping from its warehouse in Rothenthurm across Switzerland, Geneva included
company.fit_rationale: A Swiss fitness online shop that sells Barebells and TREK bars alongside Optimum Nutrition and other brands to gym-goers nationwide. It sells online only and reaches Geneva by delivery, so it sits in tier 3.

company.name: KDC Nutrition
company.distributes: Sports nutrition with protein bars (Ethic Sport), protein snacks (LifePro) and protein spreads from third-party brands
company.channels_supplied: Its online shop with delivery in Switzerland and click and collect in Vouvry
company.fit_rationale: A French language Swiss sports nutrition shop selling other brands' bars, snacks and spreads, which match Diablo's bars and spreads. It is a small online shop with one pick-up point.

company.name: La Bonbonnerie
company.distributes: Branded sweets and gummies (Haribo, Trolli), chocolate bars (Snickers), cookies and soft drinks, including loose bulk sweets
company.channels_supplied: Its online shop
company.fit_rationale: A Swiss online sweets shop selling other brands' gummies, chocolate bars and cookies, matching Diablo's sweets, chocolate and biscuits. It was founded in 2025, so its reach is small, and its delivery area is not stated on its website.

company.name: LOLA (Stiftung Contact)
company.distributes: Organic and vegan groceries with chocolate, wafer bars, crisps and snacks from other brands such as iChoc, Love Raw, Real and Rapunzel spreads; site categories for chocolate and sweets, biscuits and bars
company.channels_supplied: Two neighbourhood shops in Bern (Lorraine and Mattenhof) and its own online shop
company.sf_brands_carried: Better-for-you vegan and organic brands such as iChoc and Love Raw; no direct sugar-free competitor seen
what_they_do_well: Runs two Bern neighbourhood shops, LOLA Lorraine and LOLA Mattenhof, alongside its own online shop.
company.fit_rationale: LOLA runs two organic neighbourhood shops in Bern plus an online shop, and its own shop pages list other brands' chocolate, wafer bars and crisps. Its vegan focus suits Diablo's vegan muesli bars, wafer, cookie, peanut butters and jams.

company.name: LowPrice Sagl
company.distributes: Sweets and confectionery from about 30 brands including Haribo, Chupa Chups, Mentos, Tic Tac, Fruittella and Dietorelle, plus groceries (sweets, gummies, chocolate)
company.channels_supplied: Online grocery and household shop delivering across Switzerland, including Geneva
company.fit_rationale: A Swiss online discount grocer whose sweets section carries about 30 third-party confectionery brands and delivers nationwide, Geneva included. It already lists sugar-free sweets, so Diablo's gummies and hard sweets fit its range.

company.name: Ochsner Sport
company.distributes: Sports nutrition shelf with protein and energy bars and snacks from Barebells, Chimpanzee, Powerbar, Sponser and Winforce (bars)
company.channels_supplied: About 100 Ochsner Sport stores in Switzerland, including Geneva Balexert, Geneva Rue du Marche and Carouge, plus its online shop ochsnersport.ch
company.sf_brands_carried: Barebells protein bars with no added sugar positioning; no direct Diablo competitor seen
what_they_do_well: Grew to 100 Swiss stores in 2025 by taking over 24 former SportX stores.
Runs three stores in the Geneva area: Balexert, Rue du Marche and Carouge.
company.fit_rationale: Switzerland's largest sporting goods chain sells branded bars to health-conscious shoppers, with 284 nutrition products online and three stores in the Geneva area. Diablo's muesli and yoghurt coated bars fit next to Barebells and Chimpanzee on its nutrition shelf.

company.name: Pharmacies BENU
company.distributes: Pharmacy and health products with sports nutrition and dietetic food, including Chiefs and Sponser protein bars (bars)
company.channels_supplied: BENU pharmacy network in Switzerland and its online shop benu.ch with delivery nationwide, Geneva included; Geneva store count not stated on its website
company.fit_rationale: A Swiss pharmacy chain whose online shop sells branded protein bars in its sports nutrition and dietetics sections, giving Diablo's bars a pharmacy food shelf. Its network and online shop reach shoppers across Switzerland, including Geneva.

company.name: Planet Endurance
company.distributes: Running and trail equipment with a dietetics section of energy bars, energy gels, sports drinks and fruit pastes from Baouw and Naak
company.channels_supplied: Its store in Ecublens next to Lausanne and its online shop

company.fit_rationale: A running and trail specialist on the edge of Lausanne whose dietetics shelf sells other brands' energy bars and snacks to endurance athletes. It is a single store, so its reach is small.

company.name: ROSSMANN Schweiz AG
company.distributes: Chocolate bars (Milka, Ritter Sport), chocolate boxes and pralines (Merci, Celebrations, Daim pralines), gummies and jelly sweets (Haribo), chocolate coated fruit, dragees and mints (Wrigley's Extra) and snack bars, alongside drugstore, beauty and health products.
company.channels_supplied: Its own 27 drugstores in Switzerland, three of them in Winterthur (Archhoefe City Mall, Shopping Seen and Roemerstrasse), supported by weekly leaflets and a Swiss customer app.
what_they_do_well: Opened its first Swiss store in December 2024 and now lists 27 Swiss stores, including three in Winterthur.
Its Swiss range of about 15,000 items mixes German brands with typical Swiss brands.
company.fit_rationale: Rossmann runs 27 drugstores in German-speaking Switzerland, three of them in Winterthur, and its Swiss leaflets promote branded chocolate and sweets from Milka, Ritter Sport, Merci, Celebrations, Daim and Haribo. Rossmann-branded lines make up about 35% of its roughly 15,000 items, so most of the shelf comes from other companies' brands. what_they_do_well: Geneva running, trail and triathlon specialist since 2010, offering gait analysis and coaching.
